label: D2 after a rare a2->S1 transition, mid/late episode (trials ~45-88)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), only when the agent chose a2 and landed rarely in S1 (in_action=2, in_state=1; 13571 of 13574 dev activations). It never fires at D1 or GO, nor on common transitions or a1->S2 rare transitions. It also has a strong episode-time gate: it is silent before trial 40 and after trial 89, peaks over trials 50-89, so it only fires in the late part of the episode. The dev F1 for a2->S1 rare alone is 0.40, and adding the ep_trial window brings it to 0.71 with mass recall ~1.0. Within that set, precision is incomplete. Activations are more likely when S2 is the hidden good state (good==2 raises precision to 0.64 but drops recall to 0.86, so I did not include it), and when value is low (all activations have value < 7.54). I did not find another clean variable that separates active from inactive a2->S1 rare D2 steps. Magnitude is high on the core trial and on repeated rare a2->S1 events within a window, but I did not quantify a magnitude driver. All variables used are observable at D2; ep_trial is presumably tracked implicitly through the hidden state.
